metadata.purpose: Explicit common-name aliases for Census legal place names; no fuzzy matching or coordinate changes
metadata.geonames_attribution: Contains selected GeoNames names, https://www.geonames.org/, licensed CC BY 4.0. Aliases are linked to unchanged Census place records.

places.evidence: GeoNames primary name Boise includes Boise City as an alternate name.
GeoNames primary Nashville includes Nashville-Davidson; the municipal site identifies the consolidated government.
The county financial report identifies consolidation of the City of Macon and Bibb County into Macon-Bibb County.
The municipality uses Town of Pecos City and the municipal league lists its mailing address as Pecos, TX.
The official city site uses both La Salle and LaSalle for the same municipality.
The official village site identifies North Utica and uses Utica in its public name and postal address.
